actions.body: Save the draft as often as you need. « Issue » gives it its number for good: an issued invoice is never changed again, it is corrected by a credit note.

refused.not_issued: A draft has no Factur-X: it is written once the invoice is issued.
refused.preset_not_supported: Factur-X is written only for a French company.
refused.incomplete_document: What the EN 16931 standard asks for is missing. Fill it in, then download again:

gaps.seller_vat_number_missing: Your company’s EU VAT number (company profile)
gaps.line_tax_unsupported: Line {{line}}: tax {{code}} has no Factur-X equivalent
gaps.line_vat_ambiguous: Line {{line}}: several VAT taxes ({{codes}}), only one is allowed
gaps.vat_category_unknown: Line {{line}}: the category of VAT {{code}} is unknown
gaps.vat_exemption_undeclared: Line {{line}}: the exemption reason of the {{regime}} regime is not given
gaps.document_tax_unsupported: The document’s tax {{code}} has no Factur-X equivalent
gaps.vat_rate_shared: The {{rate}}% rate is carried by two VAT taxes ({{codes}})
gaps.vat_rounding_differs: The {{rate}}% VAT total does not add up to its lines

delivery_notes.credit_over: This delivery brings what the customer owes to {{owed}} + {{total}} {{currency}}, past their credit limit of {{limit}} {{currency}}.
delivery_notes.credit_unchecked: Credit limit not checked: the customer's position could not be read.

invoice_target.title: Where is this note invoiced?
invoice_target.help: A new invoice, or added after the lines of a draft of this customer. An issued invoice is never changed: a credit note corrects it.
invoice_target.draft: Add to a draft of {{total}} ({{lines}} lines) {{reference}}

invoice_part.title: Quantities to invoice
invoice_part.help: Each line starts at what is left of it; enter 0 to leave it off this invoice.

delivery_notes.title: Delivery notes
delivery_notes.read_only: You can read delivery notes but not change them.

fixed_notes.validated: This note is numbered and no longer changes; it can still be delivered, cancelled and printed.
fixed_notes.delivered: This note is delivered and no longer changes; it waits for its invoice and can still be printed.
fixed_notes.cancelled: This note is cancelled and no longer changes; it can still be printed.

delivery_notes.invoiced_note: This note is on an issued invoice: it is neither delivered nor cancelled any more, and can still be printed.

form.reference_hint: The customer's order number, printed on the note.
form.delivery_date_hint: The day the goods are expected; set to the day they are handed over once delivered.
form.address_hint: Left empty, the customer's shipping address, else its billing address, is printed when the note is validated.
form.notes_hint: Kept inside the company, never printed.
form.customer_hint: Type the customer's number or name; the first few found are offered.
form.customer_required: Name the customer this delivery note is for.

lines.title: Lines
lines.lot_hint: The one handed over; left empty, the lot expiring first leaves the stock.
lines.price_hint: In {{currency}}, with up to four decimals.
lines.price_unchecked: Price not checked: the customer's price list could not be read.
lines.none: No lines: a note needs at least one to be validated.

errors.quantity: A quantity above zero, with no more decimals than its unit counts (at most three).
errors.unitPriceNet: A price from 0, with up to four decimals.
errors.lotCode: Up to 40 visible characters, no spaces.

substitutes.short: Only {{quantity}} on hand of this product. In stock instead:

actions.cancel_message: A cancelled note cannot be validated or invoiced again.
actions.validate_message: It receives its number and its lines no longer change.

errors.network: The server could not be reached.
errors.conflict: The note changed state meanwhile, or its establishment has no delivery note numbering series to number it with.
errors.invalid: The note was refused. Check the customer, the lines and the dates.
errors.customer_unavailable: This customer has been deactivated since: choose another, or reactivate it on its record.

products.title: Products
products.read_only: You can read products but not change them.

form.reference_hint: Letters, digits and . _ / -, up to 32 characters, unique in the company.
form.active_hint: An inactive product stays on its documents but is no longer offered for new ones.
form.price_hint: In the company's currency, with up to four decimals.
form.cost_hint: What one unit costs you; never printed.
form.description_hint: Offered as the text of a new document line.
form.tracking_hint: Chosen before the first stock movement; a service is not tracked.
form.substitution_group_hint: Products sharing this name can stand in for one another when one is out of stock. Case is not told apart.
form.reference_hint_new: The reference shown is given when you save; type another to replace it.

errors.network: The server could not be reached.
errors.reference_taken: Another product already has this reference.
errors.name_taken: Another category already has this name.
errors.in_use: The category still holds subcategories or products.
errors.invalid: The change was refused. Check the unit, the prices and the taxes.
errors.barcode_taken: This code already belongs to another article.
errors.tracking_kept: Stock of this article has already moved: it keeps the tracking it moved under.

categories.title: Product categories
categories.intro: Categories file products in a tree. A category that still holds subcategories or products cannot be deleted.

errors.network: The server could not be reached.
errors.name_taken: Another category already has this name.
errors.in_use: This category still holds subcategories or products. Move them first.
errors.invalid: The category was refused. A category cannot sit under itself or one of its subcategories.

categories.delete_message: {{name}} will be deleted. Its products are kept.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.intro_product: What a new document line for this product starts with unless the line says otherwise. A value not set here comes from the product's category, else from the company.
defaults.intro_category: What the products filed in this category start with unless a product says otherwise. A value not set here comes from the company; a subcategory has its own values.
defaults.intro_establishment: What this establishment sets for itself alone, such as what its customer screen says of stock. A value not set here comes from the company.

errors.invalid: The values were refused. Check the limits shown.
errors.network: The server could not be reached.

homes.intro: Where this product normally lives, per establishment, in order: the first is the main one a receipt proposes. It is only a proposal: stock may be put anywhere.

reorder.title: Reorder points
reorder.intro: The quantity at or under which the product is to be reordered, per establishment. Empty: no alert.
reorder.malformed: A quantity from 0, with at most three decimals.

barcodes.intro: The codes a scanner reads for this article: its unit code, packs that count several at once, its supplier’s carton code, a code you printed. A code belongs to one article of the company only.
barcodes.scan_hint: Enter or “Add” puts it in the list, then “Save”. A scanner types the code and Enter by itself.
barcodes.duplicate: This code is already in the list, row {{row}}.
barcodes.taken: This code already belongs to article {{reference}}.

problems.code_shape: A code has 1 to 64 characters, without spaces.
problems.check_digit: The check digit does not match: check the code (EAN, UPC or GTIN-14).
problems.pack_many: A pack counts more than one piece; for one piece, choose Unit.
problems.supplier_required: Choose the supplier who prints this code.

scan.title: Scanned code
scan.none: No product of the company answers to this code.
scan.enters: {{role}}: one scan counts {{quantity}} {quantity, plural, one {piece} other {pieces}}.
scan.hint: One key is enough: Enter for the first action, the letter shown for the others, Esc to close.
scan.attach_label: Product to add this code to
scan.held_here: This code already belongs to this product.
scan.held_elsewhere: This code already belongs to {{reference}}: it cannot also go on {{here}}.

calculator.title: Price calculator
calculator.intro: Before tax, margin and markup say the same thing two ways: both start from the profit (price − cost), but margin compares it with the selling price and markup with the cost. That is why a 30 % margin gives a higher price than adding 30 % to the cost.
calculator.missing: Enter the cost and the net price to see what a unit earns.
calculator.other_margin: Adding {{percent}} % to the cost (markup) would make the price {{price}} {{currency}}.
calculator.other_markup: A margin of {{percent}} % on the price would make the price {{price}} {{currency}}.
calculator.target_margin: Cost {{cost}} ÷ (1 − {{percent}} %) = {{price}}: the profit is {{percent}} % of this price.
calculator.target_markup: Cost {{cost}} × (1 + {{percent}} %) = {{price}}: the profit is {{percent}} % of the cost.
calculator.no_price: No price gives that percentage: a margin stays under 100 %.
calculator.with_tax_unavailable: The taxes on this price cannot be counted right now.

labels.title: Product labels
labels.intro: The name, the reference, the price taxes included of what the code enters, and the code as a barcode (EAN for a GTIN, Code 128 otherwise).
labels.no_code: This product answers to no code of its own: give it a unit or internal code to print its labels.

substitutes.title: Substitutes
substitutes.intro: Other active products of the group “{{group}}”.
substitutes.ungrouped: This product has no substitution group: name one in its form to list the products that can replace it.
substitutes.none: No other active product in this group.

source.created: Set when the product was created

photos.intro: Up to {{max}} {max, plural, one {photo} other {photos}}; the main one is shown wherever the product is picked or seen, never on a printed document. Drag a photo, or use the arrows, to change the order.
photos.open: Open photo {{name}} as it was sent
photos.full: This product already has {{max}} {max, plural, one {photo} other {photos}}: remove one to add another.

errors.not_a_picture: A photo is a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture.
errors.too_large: A photo is at most {{megabytes}} MB.
errors.too_many_pixels: A photo is at most {{maxMegapixels}} megapixels.
errors.too_many_photos: A product has at most {{max}} {max, plural, one {photo} other {photos}}.
errors.changed: The photos changed meanwhile; they are up to date now.
errors.network: The server is not answering. Try again in a moment.

photos.phone_hint: The lent phone can take the photo too: it arrives here.

products.saved_as: The product was saved as {{given}}: {{shown}} was taken in the meantime.

errors.network: The server cannot be reached.
errors.code_taken: Another location of this establishment already has this code.
errors.in_use: This location cannot be deleted: it is the default location, or it still holds locations or movements.
errors.invalid: This was refused. Check the product, the location and the quantity.
errors.level_taken: Another floor of this establishment is already at that level.
errors.cost_known: The cost of this receipt is already known.

stock.title: Stock
stock.intro: A product’s stock is the sum of its movements. A validated delivery note takes the goods out of its establishment’s default location; cancelling it puts them back.
stock.release_message: Lot {{lot}} of {{product}} is past its date. Once released, a delivery note may take it again; this cannot be undone.
stock.product_hint: Type the reference or the name; only products whose stock is kept are offered.
stock.product_required: Name the product this is about.

quantity_hint.receive: The quantity received, in the product’s unit.
quantity_hint.count: The quantity found; the difference from the stock is recorded, even when nil.
quantity_hint.move: How much to move; it cannot be more than what is at the location it leaves.
quantity_hint.loss: How much to write off; it cannot be more than what is at the location.
quantity_hint.serial: A serial number is one piece: the quantity is 1.
quantity_hint.receive_split: The whole quantity received; the places below share it.

lot_hint.lot: As printed on the label; an unknown lot is opened on receipt.
lot_hint.serial: One piece per number; it is in stock only once across the company.

movement.vendor_hint: Type the number or the name; only active vendors are offered.
movement.supplier_reference_hint: The reference on the vendor’s delivery note or invoice, if any.
movement.use_by_hint: If the label carries one; a date other than the lot's own is refused.
movement.cost_hint: What one unit cost you; left empty, the average of what the stock already is, or the product’s cost price.

apply_cost.none: Leave the cost as it is

movement.apply_cost_hint: What this receipt does to the product’s cost price; the cost history keeps every change.

movements.title: Stock movements
movements.lot_search_hint: Enter to find everything that moved it; a label scanned here does the same.
movements.of_lot: Movements of lot or serial number {{code}}.

locations.title: Locations
locations.intro: Each establishment has a default location at the top of its tree. A location can be deleted only once it holds no locations and no movements.
locations.top_level: At the top of the establishment
locations.parent_hint: A location sits under another of the same establishment.
locations.code_hint: Letters, digits and . _ -, at most 32 characters, unique in the establishment.

inventory.delete_message: {{name}} will be deleted. A location that has seen a movement is kept.

plan.title: Stock plan
plan.no_floor: The plan shows where every item is kept, floor by floor. It is drawn in three steps:
plan.nothing_drawn: No location is drawn on this floor yet.
plan.plan_of: Plan of {{floor}}: {{count}} {count, plural, one {rectangle} other {rectangles}} drawn
plan.trace_hint: Drag on the plan to trace the footprint, then choose the location.
plan.pose_rule: Choose a shape: it is placed in the middle of the plan, selected. Drag it or type its measurements, then Save.
plan.level_hint: The ground floor is 0; a storey above it is a larger number, up to 200.
plan.location_hint: A location is in one place, so it is drawn once. Bins are not offered.
plan.footprint_hint: In metres from the floor’s top-left corner, snapped to the quarter-metre.
plan.rotation_hint: In steps of 15°, for a rack set against a wall at an angle.
plan.structure_note: Nothing here is a stock location: a wall holds no goods and appears on no list.
plan.structure_hint: What this piece draws. A door and a dock are cut into a wall: their thickness is the wall's.
plan.structure_name_hint: The name the store already uses, if it has one.
plan.layer_locked: Lock this layer so the pointer no longer catches it
plan.repeat_spacing_hint: The free floor between two rectangles. Zero puts them back to back.
plan.repeat_off_floor: A copy would leave the floor. Change the direction, the spacing or the count.
plan.repeat_incomplete: Give a count, a spacing and a code ending in a number.
plan.views: Ways to look at the floor

view_coming.facade: A rack’s front, its columns and levels, is coming soon.

plan.floor_meta: Level {{level}} · {{count}} {count, plural, one {location drawn} other {locations drawn}}
plan.arrange_hint: Drag a shape to move it, its handles to resize it; nothing is saved until Save.
plan.read_note: Reading: touching the plan moves nothing
plan.press_hint: Press a place to see what it holds.
plan.keys_hint: Wheel or + / − to come nearer, arrows to move around
plan.board: Floor plan. + and − to come nearer, arrows to move around.
plan.panel_hint_read: Touch a rectangle on the plan, or pick it in the list, to see what it holds.
plan.panel_hint_arrange: Pick a shape to place: it lands in the middle, selected. Drag it or type its measurements, then Save.

here.title: What is here
here.nothing: Nothing is stored here, according to the recorded movements.
here.more: {{count}} more {count, plural, one {line} other {lines}}: see them all in Stock
here.empty_home: {{product}} has its place here ({{place}}) and none is left: empty, to be refilled.
here.truth: What this says comes from the recorded movements: goods received into a place under this one count here.

search.label: Find a product
search.hint: Reference, name or barcode, or scan
search.nowhere: No stock is recorded for this product.
search.places_here: {{count}} {count, plural, one {place} other {places}} on this floor
search.note_nowhere: {{count}} {count, plural, one {line} other {lines}} not found on the plan
search.line_nowhere: No stock is recorded for this product.
search.nowhere_drawn: This item is in no drawn place.

volume.note: The 3D is for looking only. To change anything, go back to the 2D plan.
volume.keys_hint: Drag to turn, wheel to come nearer, Shift and drag to move
volume.summary: {{floor}}: {{racks}} {racks, plural, one {rack} other {racks}}, {{zones}} {zones, plural, one {zone} other {zones}}
volume.missing: This browser cannot show the 3D (WebGL 2 is not available here). The 2D plan shows the same floor.
volume.failed: The 3D view could not be loaded. The 2D plan shows the same floor.
volume.read_only: The 3D is looked at in View; in Arrange, the plan is 2D.

first.title: Draw your depot
first.wider: The plan is drawn on a wider screen. Here it is read, searched and scanned.
first.ask: The first floor is drawn by someone who may arrange the stock.

steps.measure: Measure the floor, its width and its depth
steps.build: Put up the walls, doors and posts (optional)
steps.place: Place your racks and zones, each on its stock location

scan.filled: {{name}}: article, lot and quantity filled in

count.title: Count
count.intro: Choose the location, or scan its label, then scan what is there. Each line can be corrected by hand; recording sets the location's stock to what was counted, for what was scanned only.
count.incomplete: Every line needs a quantity, and a tracked article its lot.
count.read_only: You may count, but not record: recording needs the right to write stock.

labels.title: Location labels
labels.intro: One label per location, to stick on the shelf: a phone reading its QR code opens count mode at that location, and a scanner recognises it too.

valuation.title: Stock valuation
valuation.forbidden: Reading what the stock is worth needs the right to read what things cost.
valuation.unvalued_note: Stock with no known cost is counted apart and left out of the total: give it a cost on its next receipt, or a cost price on the product.
valuation.estimated_note: Part of the stock has no recorded cost: it is estimated at the product’s cost price now, and its value is marked “estimated”.

placement.one_place: Put it all in one place
placement.rest: Put the rest in the default place
placement.counting: Each row: what was found at that place, 0 if nothing.
placement.uncounted: Enter what was found at each place, 0 if nothing.

receipt_cost.title: Cost of the receipt
receipt_cost.intro: This receipt was recorded by someone who cannot see costs. Enter what one unit cost: once entered, it does not change.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.read_only: You can read vendors but not change them.

form.number_hint: Letters, digits and . _ / -, up to 32 characters, unique in the company.
form.active_hint: An inactive vendor stays on its expenses but is no longer offered for new ones.
form.country_hint: Two letters, such as TN or FR. Left empty, the company's country.
form.iban_hint: The account the vendor is paid on; spaces are removed.
form.terms_hint: Days after the vendor's invoice its payment is due, from 0 to 365.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.read_only: You can read expenses but not change them.

fixed_notes.recorded: This expense is recorded in the books: it can be paid, and a late receipt can still be attached, but it no longer changes.
fixed_notes.paid: This expense is paid and no longer changes; a late receipt can still be attached.

form.reference_hint: The number on the vendor's invoice or receipt.
form.vendor_hint: Type the number or the name; only active vendors are offered. Choosing one fills an empty category with the vendor's usual one.
form.payee_hint: When no recorded vendor fits: a car park, a notary, a public office.
form.net_hint: Before tax, with no more decimals than the currency has.
form.withholding_hint: Proposed at 1% from 1,000 TND including VAT; enter 0 for an excluded purchase or an exempt supplier, or the rate that applies to the supplier.
form.tej_hint: The TEJ platform code under which this withholding is declared.

attachments.title: Receipts
attachments.hint: PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB and 10 files. The type is read from the file itself.

categories.title: Expense categories
categories.intro: Expenses are filed in a tree of categories. A category is deactivated rather than deleted, so the expenses already filed under it keep it.
categories.active_hint: An inactive category stays on its expenses but is no longer offered for new ones.

errors.network: The server could not be reached.

errors.name_taken: Another category under the same parent already has this name.
errors.invalid: The change was refused. Check the vendor, the category, the tax and the amount.
errors.file_refused: The file was refused: it must be a PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP image of up to 10 MB, not empty, and the expense may hold at most 10 files.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.period_closed: The books are closed on that day: choose a day after the closing.

tej_file.title: The month's TEJ file
tej_file.intro: The month's withholdings at source, in the TEJ platform's format (initial filing, acte 0), for you to file on the platform yourself.

problems.tax_rate_too_precise: VAT rate with more than two decimals

forgot.sent: If this address has an account, a link is on its way. It works for one hour.

invoice.definition: The document that records a sale. It takes its number when issued, with no gap in the series, and is never changed afterwards: a credit note corrects it.

credit_note.definition: The document that cancels or reduces all or part of an issued invoice, without ever changing it.

quote.definition: A priced offer made to the customer; once accepted, it can become an invoice or a delivery note.

delivery_note.definition: It goes with the goods handed to the customer; once validated, it takes them out of stock.

stamp_duty.definition: A fixed duty that the Tunisian finance law adds to every invoice.

withholding.definition: The part of a payment the customer keeps and pays to the State itself on behalf of its supplier, who deducts it from its own tax.

vat_franchise.definition: A small French business that does not charge VAT, below turnover thresholds; its invoices say so.

reverse_charge.definition: The customer declares and pays the VAT; the invoice says so.
